Buffalo Supply, Inc.
distributes surgical implants, orthopedic hardware, prosthetics, and hospital equipment to federal government agencies, but they do not focus on or distribute consumer or patient wearable medical devices (such as smart health monitors or continuous trackers).

Core Focus Areas
Federal Marketplace:
Connects medical device makers to VA and DoD facilities.
Surgical & Orthopedic:
Supplies joint implants, trauma products, and surgical tools.
Prosthetics:
Manages delivery for standard prosthetic appliances and implants.
